backend/main.mo: Main canister implementing authorization, movie CRUD with video blob upload, user profiles, and admin-claim bootstrapping.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module converting old movie records with video URLs into new records using optional video blobs.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report describing the admin-only video upload feature and its related frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of all frontend files for reference, including pages, components, and hooks.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based style sheet defining OKLCH color tokens and dark mode variables for the app theme.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router routes, theming, global toasts, and profile setup modal for the React app.
frontend/src/components/admin/MovieEdito: Admin dialog for creating and editing movies with support for video file upload and progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/admin/MovieListI: Renders an admin movie list item with poster preview, edit dialog, and delete confirmation.
frontend/src/components/auth/AdminRouteG: Protects admin routes by redirecting non-admin users and displaying a loader while checking authorization.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button using Internet Identity with loading states and query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Shows a modal prompting authenticated users without a profile to enter their name and saves it.
frontend/src/components/layout/Footer.ts: Renders the site footer with branding, a link to caffeine.ai, and the current year.
frontend/src/components/layout/Header.ts: Displays the site header with navigation, logo, and login button, including an admin link when authorized.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteLayou: Wraps the page with a header, footer, and main content outlet.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the current identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuthorization.ts: Checks authentication state and queries whether the current user is an admin.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context including identity loading, login, and logout handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useMovieMutations.ts: Defines mutations for adding, updating, and deleting movies, including optional video uploads and progress tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides queries for movies and the caller's user profile, plus a mutation to save the profile.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles and theme variables for light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AccessDeniedPage.tsx: Shows an access-denied message with a prompt to return to the catalog.
frontend/src/pages/AdminMoviesPage.tsx: Admin page for listing, creating, and managing movies with a create-dialog trigger.
frontend/src/pages/CatalogPage.tsx: Displays a movie catalog with a hero section, loading skeletons, empty state, and a grid of movie cards linking to detail pages.
frontend/src/pages/MovieDetailPage.tsx: Shows detailed movie info with a video player, poster sidebar, loading skeletons, and a not‑found state.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helper functions for reading, storing, persisting, and clearing URL parameters and session-based parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures TailwindCSS theme settings, colors, typography, animations, and plugins for the frontend.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s current state, features, requirements, and architectural notes for the Movie Sphere app.
